# Creative projects: watch a drawing come together

> Watch recorded Aquarell and VectorPaint workflows, with written steps for composition, colour and the finished artwork.

## Reading context

These are guides and product information from Bison, the developer of the six apps; they are not independent reviews or rankings.
Markdown is another representation of the same HTML content. Read feature limits, source attributions and version notes in the linked page. English pages are translations of the Chinese originals.
Read each recording note for simulator, local-build and editing details; footage does not establish feature parity with the store release.

## Creation walkthroughs

- [Greenhouse Café: build an isometric scene with 29 closed paths in VectorPaint](https://allluckly.cn/en/works/vectorpaint-greenhouse-cafe-duo/index.md): Use closed pen paths, six flat colours and the Geometry form in VectorPaint on an iPhone Duo simulator to build a greenhouse, glazing, awning, two plants and four paving stones. Follow 29 closed paths, corrected pot positions and early path-closure fixes, with the native 1080×1080 PNG. Originally published: 2026-10-24. Recorded with a local VectorPaint build, 1.0.7 (6), in an iPhone Duo / iOS 27.1 simulator with a Chinese interface. AI assists actual editor interactions. The video starts with filling an existing base contour, follows creation order and removes waiting. Footage plays at 1–1.5×, with speeds stated in the English and Chinese subtitles. No audio. The native PNG is followed by four real window screenshots showing the Duo poses as separate steps, rather than continuous folding footage. Store-version layouts may differ.
- [A rainy window in Aquarell: 13 layers for rain, warm light and a book with coffee](https://allluckly.cn/en/works/aquarell-rainy-window-duo/index.md): Build a cool-blue city, rain-streaked glass, a warm lamp, book, coffee and plant with Aquarell selections, brushes and 13 layers. Includes a real creation video, bilingual subtitles, colours, concrete steps and the native 1400×1000 artwork. Originally published: 2026-10-24. Recorded with a local Aquarell build, 1.0.5 (1), in an iPhone Duo / iOS 27.1 simulator with a Chinese interface. AI assists native drawing through the app’s official MCP tools. The video continues from a saved base, follows creation order and removes waiting. Footage plays at 1–2×, with speeds stated in the English and Chinese subtitles. No audio. The native PNG is followed by four real window screenshots showing the Duo poses as separate steps, rather than continuous folding footage. Store-version layouts may differ.
- [Cape Lighthouse: build a geometric seascape with 17 closed paths in VectorPaint](https://allluckly.cn/en/works/vectorpaint-cape-lighthouse-duo/index.md): Use closed pen paths, fills and strokes in VectorPaint on an iPhone Duo simulator to build a sun, mountains, sea, cape and lighthouse. Follow the stacking of 17 objects, a window-closure mistake and three separate wave highlights. Originally published: 2026-10-23. Recorded in an iPhone Duo simulator using a local VectorPaint build, 1.0.7 (6), with a Chinese interface. Selected drawing steps play at 2–4× speed; the finished PNG is shown for 2 seconds. The last 20 seconds are sampled simulator-window views of folding steps, with waiting removed. No narration; English and Chinese subtitles are available. Store-version features and layouts may differ.
- [Moonlit Pines: build a geometric night landscape with Aquarell polygon selections](https://allluckly.cn/en/works/aquarell-moonlit-pines-duo/index.md): Use polygon selections, fills and four layers in Aquarell on an iPhone Duo simulator to make snowy mountains, three pines, a moon, twelve stars and lake reflections. Includes a chaptered video, a five-colour palette and the native 1400×1000 PNG. Originally published: 2026-10-23. Recorded in an iPhone Duo simulator using a local Aquarell build, 1.0.5 (1), with a Chinese interface. Selected drawing steps play at 1.2–2× speed; the finished PNG is shown for 2 seconds. The last 20 seconds are sampled simulator-window views of the folding steps, with waiting removed. No narration; English and Chinese subtitles are available. Store-version features and layouts may differ.
- [Aquarell creative process: paint a night scene with soft pools of light](https://allluckly.cn/en/works/aquarell-night-glow/index.md): Layer short mint, lilac and warm-white brush marks over deep blue to practise brush size, opacity and empty space. Includes the recorded workflow, colour settings and native exported artwork. Originally published: 2026-10-23. Recorded in an iPhone Duo simulator using a local Aquarell build, 1.0.5 (build 1), with a Chinese interface. These are excerpts of real app interaction; selected clips play at 1.1–1.7× speed. No narration; English and Chinese step subtitles are available. Recording starts with the deep-blue canvas already filled. The finished image was exported directly from the app. Store-version features and layouts may differ.
- [VectorPaint creative process: a sunset mountain scene in three colours](https://allluckly.cn/en/works/vectorpaint-geometric-sunset/index.md): Start with a square canvas, close an octagon and two triangles with the pen, then set fills, turn off strokes and export PNG. Originally published: 2026-10-23. Recorded in an iPhone Duo simulator using a local VectorPaint build, 1.0.7 (build 6), with a Chinese interface. These are excerpts of real app interaction; selected clips play at 1.1–1.5× speed. No narration; English and Chinese step subtitles are available. The finished image below was exported directly from the app. Store-version features and layouts may differ.
